applies_why: The judge text decides that Luke 2:48-49 was answered, so the rule governing whether that verse counts as an unanswered witness applies.
quote: D4 vs C2 (Luke 2:48-49): UNDERDETERMINED -- answered in [CR2] §5 and [CR3] LINK 4; Mary's phrase "thy father" is immediately qualified by the child's reference to "my Father's business."
rule_words: If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.
why: Because the judge says the verse was answered and does not count it as an unanswered witness, the text obeys K-G4.
